source_slots.objects: Actual Phi,S,lambda,R,strict prescribed Gamma with post-bounce event values; target U=V(x)+||x-y||²/(2η)+||p||²/2, not shifted conserved harmonic H.
source_slots.domains: Finite real Hilbert/Borel E; all n≥0,T≥0, strict times; actual real time interval integral against Lebesgue. Include rank0,empty tuple,T0,zero-normal.
source_slots.quantifiers: Every y,r,z,n,T and strict prescribed tuple under fixed V,alpha,beta,eta.
source_slots.assumptions: Original six: alpha>0,alpha<=beta,V C2,global quadratic-form Hessian bounds,eta>0,beta eta<=1. Actual finite-arc continuity/integration proved, not new premises.
source_slots.conclusion: Both lambda(Gamma) and lambda(R Gamma) interval integrable; U(Gamma(T))-U(z)=Iplus-Iminus; exp(-U(z))*exp(-Iplus)=exp(-U(Gamma(T)))*exp(-Iminus).
source_slots.scopes: Finite Gibbs/survival identity only; jump factors, reverse-time prescribed arc matching, weightedTheta,stationary averaging,A3,invariance remain later.
source_slots.constant_dependencies: Rate sqrt eta times max positive actual gradient difference pairing; trigonometric time unscaled; U depends V,eta,y not r; common source density normalizer cancels.

source_proof_reconstruction: Differentiate target U along harmonic ODE; quadratic-force terms cancel to sqrt eta p·(gradV(x)-gradV(r)).
Positive-part algebra equals lambda-lambdaR, opposite sign from derivative log density.
Bounce fixes x and momentum norm, hence U; R also preserves U.
Integrate actual deterministic arcs with continuous actual rates; finite endpoints can be ignored for integration.
Sum arc increments and cancel U at bounce boundaries; obtain terminal-minus-initial U=Iplus-Iminus.
Exponentiate exact equality to homogeneous Gibbs/survival formula.
